verdict.rationale: Claude's support docs say individual users can export their user information and chat history from Settings > Privacy, and that exports include both conversation data and account user data. That covers both halves of the story. Enterprise customers also get programmatic access to chat histories through the Compliance API. Missing for 10: export format and delivery details, confirmation that project files, artifacts and memory are included in the 'complete' export, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the export working.
